scope: All unique repository links directly in the collection README; no recursive catalog expansion.
method: README and root listing inspected for all 96 repositories; selected additional documentation/source inspected where needed. No project execution or experiment reproduction.
provenance_note: Observed commits come from repository root pages fetched alongside READMEs. A HEAD source URL records retrieval, not a guarantee of future immutability; its SHA-256 identifies the inspected content.
